purpose: Fictional records for practicing evidence correlation, timestamp normalization and limits of inference. This is a repository-defined envelope, not a native application or operating-system event schema.
global_assumptions: All accounts, hosts, paths, events and service operations are fictional LAB identities. No external service was used to create this fixture.
All media and CSV material is assumed benign. No file payload is included or acquired.
Every sha256 is null because no artifact bytes were acquired or measured. Filenames, claimed sizes and copy success do not substitute for byte identity.
Clock offsets are stipulated teaching assumptions, not measured corrections. Positive offset means recorded wall time is ahead of the reference time.
Normalized time equals the raw timestamp interpreted in its declared timezone minus the stipulated clock offset. Ordering remains conditional on that clock model.
Event identifiers are fixture labels. They are not Windows Event IDs or vendor schema identifiers.
